I have nothing on Telltale in the files available to me, so I can't say what they instructed. Even if I did, one client's instructions are confidential to that client, and I wouldn't use them as a template for Joad. Joad's approach should come from Joad's own instructions and the firm's general practice.

**Expert report review (Joad)**
- The General Counsel, Evander Thorsby, wants to review the names and credentials of all proposed testifying experts before engagement. We should expect to send prior-testimony notes as well.
- He wants to know whether anyone will speak to industry practice. Any standards or industry-practice expert must be cleared with him before engagement.
- He prefers that design testimony stay focused on the specific product at issue. He is glad to help identify candidates who have served on standards bodies.
- Joad's file doesn't mention a regulatory-consistency review of expert reports. Ask Evander whether he wants one, and build client review time into the expert schedule either way.
- Budget: Joad wants quotes before any testing is commissioned, and wants to know who pays for shared lab work. It also gives 10 days' notice of any proposed testing. Expert and testing costs tend to drive most budget variance.

**Timing of settlement talks (Joad)**
- Joad's file doesn't set a timeline for opening talks. It sets approval gates that control when anything can go out.
- Confirm the current pre-approved settlement authority for C-2. The insurer sets it, and the file doesn't state the amount.
- If an offer is within the insurer's tier, check with Evander before conveying it.
- If an offer is above that tier, it needs written board consent. Verbal indications from a director or officer are not enough, and we should not communicate even a signal above the pre-approved level without the document.
- The board consent takes about three weeks, so flag any likely need for higher authority early.
- Copy Perpetua Wallace, the insurer's claims handler, on anything bearing on coverage. Joad wants to hear the same day if the carrier reserves its rights.
- Joad has a $400,000 retention and an aggregate limit it watches closely because of other open claims. This should shape how we frame exposure and settlement ranges.

**Next steps**
- Confirm the C-2 authority amount with Evander.
- Calendar the expert-clearance and board-consent lead times.
- Calendar Joad's reporting deadlines: first case assessment within 60 days, phase budget within 45 days, and a written report every six weeks.

If you have Telltale's instructions from a source you're authorized to share, send them and I'll compare. Otherwise, I can draft a short note to Evander proposing an expert-clearance and settlement-authority protocol for C-2.
